correctness.rationale: The Stratonovich equation has Itô spatial drift D R(phi)Jc and angular diffusivity alpha=Db. Schur complement Q=a I-cc^T/b>0 supplies independent angular and translational innovations. The angular derivative identity d[R(phi)Jc]=-R(phi)c dphi-alpha R(phi)Jc dt holds only on continuous reset excursions; resetting orientation does not move X. Regenerative renewal-reward covariance uses E[(Y-vT)(Y-vT)^T]/E T and gives the stated rational functions for both axes. Independent exact SymPy substitution from the earlier full all-mobility tensor gives zero difference for both new covariance rates and their gap; its factored optimizer gives r=2alpha and gap=10D gamma^2/(27b). These are analytically justified CLT rates, not an inference from logs alone.
residual_risks: No simulation of trajectories was used to establish the regenerative CLT; all required finite cycle moments are explicit.
